name: Smart India Hackathon
how_to_join: Registration runs through your college's SPOC and an internal hackathon. Ask your HOD or innovation cell, form a team as per the current rules, then pick a problem statement on the official portal.

name: Google Summer of Code
how_to_join: Start contributing to an open-source organisation early (look for good-first-issues), then write a proposal when applications open. Check eligibility on the official site.

name: Kaggle Competitions
how_to_join: Create a free account, finish a Kaggle Learn micro-course, then try a 'Getting Started' competition.

name: LeetCode and Codeforces Weekly Contests
how_to_join: Create a free account and join the next weekly contest. Even solving one or two problems builds the habit. Codeforces (codeforces.com/contests) is another good option.

name: Campus Mock Placement Drive
how_to_join: Watch for Training & Placement announcements and register early. Run your resume through the AI Resume Advisor first, because campus drives need an ATS score of 75% or more.

name: Cloud and DevOps Workshop
how_to_join: Ask your department or tech club about upcoming workshops, and prepare with the free labs on AWS Skill Builder (skillbuilder.aws).

name: Web Development Bootcamp
how_to_join: Follow the free freeCodeCamp curriculum, build one small project, and present it at your club or department showcase.

name: IoT and Embedded Design Challenge
how_to_join: Join your department's electronics or robotics club and start with a small sensor or microcontroller project.

name: Research Paper Presentation and Symposium
how_to_join: Talk to a faculty mentor about a paper idea, start with a short literature review, and target a student track at a symposium.

name: Major League Hacking (MLH) Student Hackathons
how_to_join: Browse the current season's events on the site, pick a beginner-friendly one, and team up with friends.

name: Unstop Competitions
how_to_join: Create a free profile and filter by your interests to find competitions, quizzes and hackathons open to college students.

name: University Sports and Cultural Teams
how_to_join: Join tryouts through your sports or cultural committee. When you officially represent the university, ask for an event duty slip, since attendance lost this way can be condoned.

name: Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) Activities
how_to_join: Attend the next E-Cell meeting, pitch or join an idea, and volunteer for one event to meet like-minded people.
